name: pam_cap
detailed_description: POSIX capabilities module that assigns Linux capabilities to user processes. Restricts privileged operations without requiring root access. Fine-grained privilege management alternative to traditional suid binaries.
notes:
Sets POSIX capabilities for user sessions
